act.name: Constitution of India
act.source_name: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
act.description: The supreme law of India establishing fundamental rights, directive principles, and government structure.

sections.title: Protection of life and personal liberty
sections.text: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
sections.plain_language_summary: Guarantees the fundamental right to life, personal liberty, privacy, dignity, and livelihood to every person in India.
